name: Imprint Glove
summary: A wearable tactile-data acquisition system using separate fingertip sensors and wrist hubs. It outputs structured 3D contact-position and 3D contact-force data for multimodal training, with USB/serial connectivity and ROS, ROS2, Python and C development support.

description.en: A wearable tactile-data acquisition system using separate fingertip sensors and wrist hubs. It outputs structured 3D contact-position and 3D contact-force data for multimodal training, with USB/serial connectivity and ROS, ROS2, Python and C development support.
